## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Mario-inspired basketball game for phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Um jogo do Mario que jogando basquete (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)”.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained static browser game with Three.js from a CDN, Portuguese UI, touch-first aiming and shooting, and a 60-second arcade round.
- Used a procedurally modeled Mario-inspired character and Mushroom Kingdom court rather than external art assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html` with responsive HUD, start/end overlays, score/timer/combo indicators, and touch controls.

- Started a local server on port 3002 and opened it in Playwright.

- Validate gameplay, visual rendering, and phone/tablet layout; save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

- No current blocker. Playwright initially lacked Chromium; installed it with `playwright-cli install-browser chromium`.

Assumi uma versão arcade para navegador, com elementos 3D criados proceduralmente e sem imagens externas.
